name: MIDI Pack Preflight
summary: Audit a MIDI release pack locally for malformed or empty files, portability risks, duplicate performances, and path collisions before upload.
customer: Independent English-market music producers and boutique sample-pack labels that sell original ZIP packs containing roughly 20 to 2,000 Standard MIDI files.
problem: Large MIDI packs can contain malformed chunks, empty musical content, hanging notes, less-portable format features, duplicate performances, or colliding release paths that are tedious to catch by importing files one at a time.
solution: A downloadable offline browser utility that audits one ZIP or direct MIDI selection with deterministic Standard MIDI and bundle-hygiene checks, hashes files locally, and exports CSV plus self-contained HTML evidence.

acceptance_checks.description: Valid format 0 and format 1 fixtures report expected header, timing, track, channel, note, range, duration, tempo, key, and time-signature facts with zero structural blockers.
Every approved malformed header, track, variable-length, running-status, data-byte, meta/system, and end-of-track fixture reports its stable check ID and path without crashing the remaining scan.
Empty content, unmatched notes, format 2, SMPTE timing, system-exclusive data, conflicting declarations, and non-ASCII text produce review findings rather than unsupported compatibility verdicts.
Exact bytes, normalized performance duplicates, distinct performances, case-insensitive path collisions, and non-MIDI release files are grouped exactly without modifying inputs.
CSV and self-contained HTML reports contain release facts, configured limits, every path, SHA-256, parsed MIDI facts, stable findings, evidence, and limitations in an offline no-storage workflow.
Unsafe paths, damaged archives, unsupported selections, nested archives, and file, archive, count, entry, expansion, and path limits fail safely with customer-facing messages.
The deterministic versioned buyer ZIP contains only the application, instructions, support, and dependency notices with restrictive CSP and no development files.
Deterministic fictional fixtures generate four 1600x900 release-review images plus exact sample HTML and CSV reports without customer, payment, or confidential data.
The product pull request passes manifest validation plus clean-install unit, release-package, and Chromium offline-browser checks on GitHub Actions.
